title: Enroll in E-Verify and verify new hires (Louisiana)
authority: Louisiana employment eligibility law / U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services
description: Louisiana permits an employer to verify each employee through E-Verify or to collect and retain copies of specified identity and work-authorization documents.

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register.

penalty.note: No fine is stated; an employer without the E-Verify affidavit can lose public contracts and be ineligible for them for up to three years.
